notes.title: "Next Fest" is now live, and the new class, Paladin, now available for trial!
notes.content:
The trial version is packed with excitement!
You'll not only get to experience the two new Paladin heroes, "Steve" and "WangDaChui",
but also have the chance to tackle the new stage, "Lost Town" (which unlocks under specific conditions).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171862/217c80a7306695504055f02ef94f82a09a07e7d7.png

Throughout this roughly 4-hour journey,
you'll delve into each character's unique talents and abilities through the demo,
unlock ample rewards, confront powerful bosses,
and appreciate the boundless charm of the game's skill-reward synergy!


Remember to choose your rune before starting, as it will aid you in defeating enemies more efficiently.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171862/513c2daea79d63cfbb161c4f334d52b2f45cd152.jpg

Thank you for downloading and trying out the game.      We hope to create an even more satisfying experience for our players.
For any feedback or suggestions, please join our QQ group: 775423813.
